hypothesis: Already-selected broad-market leadership paper candidates with high absolute composite score may carry standalone quality beyond relative rank; a bounded support notional scalar can improve allocation after the accepted rank, low-extension, high-volatility, and trend-persistence stack.

identity_control.interpretation: The current local broad-market replay inputs do not reproduce the accepted exp-20260520-004 artifact exactly. This blocks promotion even if a support scalar had passed the field-specific gate.

interpretation: Absolute composite score has positive aggregate replacement value but does not clear the broad-market paper gate: the best variant regresses one window and worsens max drawdown beyond the guardrail. The broad-market sleeve should collect forward outcomes instead of adding another frozen-window support scalar.
known_risks: Historical replay depends on the local exp-20260519-030 warehouse.
The adjusted cohort is still paper-only; forward paper evidence remains required before any trade-enabled adapter.
The score field is already part of ranking, so support scalars can easily become hidden rank leverage.

llm_metrics.reason: This run avoids sparse LLM soft-ranking and does not alter LLM prompts or decisions.

next_evidence_needed: Collect forward broad-market paper outcomes with absolute-score metadata; do not retry adjacent score-support thresholds on the frozen sample without new forward evidence or a distinct quality field.

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool/capital allocation: high absolute composite score may deserve bounded paper notional support after selection.
protocol_answers.2_past_similar_experiments: Broad-market price-floor, rank-notional, low-extension ret5, high-volatility, trend-persistence, and strong-close crowding were tested; absolute composite-score support was not previously formalized for this sleeve.
protocol_answers.3_single_variable: Only score_min/scalar changes inside one notional-support field; eligibility, rank profile, low-extension, high-volatility, trend-persistence, hold, slots, and universe controls stay fixed.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance: Gate 4 requires positive aggregate EV/PnL, all 3 windows EV-positive, no EV/PnL regression windows, >=8 adjusted trades across all 3 windows, concentration guard, and <=0.5pp max drawdown worsening.
protocol_answers.5_reproducibility: Script, JSON artifact, log, ticket, markdown artifact, and JSONL identify windows, parameters, and metrics.

rejection_reason: Best absolute-score support variant had positive aggregate EV/PnL but failed Gate 4 on one EV/PnL-regressed window and max-drawdown drift; the no-support identity control also drifted versus the accepted exp-20260520-004 artifact, so no policy can be promoted.

shared_adapter_parity.reason: Gate 4 failed; no shared broad-market policy or production adapter change is retained.

single_causal_variable: absolute composite-score support scalar for fixed broad-market selected candidates
